findings.evidence: Lines 140–147 explicitly retain package-directory callers but immediately scan only that directory; `Completed` is added only on the repository-root branch at lines 150–153, and the new test covers only `canonical_areas(root)`.
findings.fix: Normalize a package-directory argument to its repository parent before scanning both `TauCetiRoadmap/` and `Completed/`, and test both accepted argument forms.
findings.issue: `canonical_areas` returns only active areas when passed the supported `TauCetiRoadmap/` package directory, silently omitting its sibling `Completed/`; the same checkout therefore produces different canonical sets depending on the accepted path form.

summary: The helper accepts two directory levels but only discovers completed areas from one, leaving its advertised package-directory form under-generalized.
